rows.note: Use 有愛心 as the all-purpose choice for a kind and caring person.

example.english: My younger sister is very caring and often feeds stray cats.
example.traditional: 我阿妹好有愛心，成日餵街貓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 mui6 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1 sing4 jat6 wai3 gaai1 maau1

rows.note: Choose 體貼 when the person shows care by noticing and responding to other people's needs.

example.english: You’re so caring—you knew I was ill and even made congee for me.
example.traditional: 你真係好體貼，知道我病咗仲特登煲粥畀我。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 tip3 zi1 dou3 ngo5 beng6 zo2 zung6 dak6 dang1 bou1 zuk1 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Choose 有同理心 specifically when emphasizing empathy and the ability to understand another person's feelings.

example.english: A social worker needs to be caring and understand why people are upset.
example.traditional: 做社工最緊要有同理心，明白人哋點解難過。
example.jyutping: zou6 se5 gung1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 jau5 tung4 lei5 sam1 ming4 baak6 jan4 dei6 dim2 gaai2 naan4 gwo3

rows.note: Choose 善解人意 when the caring person is especially good at understanding unspoken feelings or intentions.

example.english: They’re very caring; they know I’m unhappy as soon as I frown.
example.traditional: 佢好善解人意，我一皺眉，佢就知我唔開心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sin6 gaai2 jan4 ji3 ngo5 jat1 zau3 mei4 keoi5 zau6 zi1 ngo5 m4 hoi1 sam1
